data.key: Sorcerer Bonus Spell L1 ~ Mage Armor
data.name: Mage Armor
data.description: An invisible but tangible field of force surrounds the subject of a mage armor spell, providing a +4 armor bonus to AC. Unlike mundane armor, mage armor entails no armor check penalty, arcane spell failure chance, or speed reduction. Since mage armor is made of force, incorporeal creatures can't bypass it the way they do normal armor.|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell

raw_tokens.value: Sorcerer Bonus Spell L1 ~ Mage Armor
Grants a +4 armor bonus to AC

An invisible but tangible field of force surrounds the subject of a mage armor spell, providing a +4 armor bonus to AC. Unlike mundane armor, mage armor entails no armor check penalty, arcane spell failure chance, or speed reduction. Since mage armor is made of force, incorporeal creatures can't bypass it the way they do normal armor.|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
